descFull: Beta. Self-hosted VPN panel for family, friends or a small team: Hysteria2, VLESS REALITY, AmneziaWG and TrustTunnel, one link per person. Add servers from the browser over SSH; one TCP 443 for several protocols, decoy sites from a template, health checks, Telegram alerts, MCP for AI agents. Two Go binaries, SQLite, no Docker.
